name: MegaSaw
tagline: A bigger SuperSaw oscillator: two layers of JP-8000 style supersaw, 3 to 11 voices per layer, each layer with its own waveform, plus analog-style drift.
screen_note: The xd shows typeless parameters (Wave A and Wave B) one higher than the number the code uses, so they read 1 to 10. Oct B, Layer Bal, Voices and Drift show a percent sign.

knobs.name: SHAPE
knobs.what: Detune, JP-8000 curve. The xd's LFO and mod routing can sweep it.

knobs.name: SHIFT + SHAPE
knobs.what: Mix: centre voice against the side voices.

params.Wave A: Waveform of layer A (list below). If both layers are Off, layer A plays Supersaw.
params.Wave B: Waveform of layer B (1 = layer B off).
params.Oct B: Octave of layer B against layer A. The screen shows %, read it as octaves.
params.Layer Bal: -100% = only layer A, 0% = equal, +100% = only layer B.
params.Voices: Voices per layer: -2 = 3, -1 = 5, 0 = 7, +1 = 9, +2 = 11. The screen shows %, read it as the step. Loudness stays the same.
params.Drift: Each voice slowly wanders in pitch, like analog (0 to 100%).

notes: If both layers are Off (screen 1), layer A plays Supersaw so you never get silence.
starters: Classic JP lead: Wave A 2 (Supersaw), Wave B 1, Voices 0, Shape about 60%, Shift+Shape about 70%.
Mega stack: Wave A 2, Wave B 2, Oct B -1, Voices +2, Layer Bal 0, Drift about 30%, Shape about 70%.
Hardstyle Ah lead: Wave A 10 (Vox Ah), Wave B 2, Layer Bal -20, Voices +1, Drift about 30%, Shape about 70%, Shift+Shape about 60%, short decay, sustain about 35%.
Pure choir: Wave A 10, Wave B 1, Shape about 25%, slow attack.
Trance pad: Wave A 2, Wave B 8 (Glass 1), Oct B +1, Layer Bal -30, Drift about 40%.
problems: The xd plays up to 4 notes and each note runs its own copy of the oscillator, so 2 layers of 11 voices can be too much for a busy chord. Lower Voices first, then turn layer B off (Wave B 1). Vox Ah and Glass waves cost more than saws.
status: Version 1.0. The unit in dist/ was built from this repo's source.

Tested on a PC only (test/ folder): every wave, voice count and extreme setting renders without NaN, clipping or DC offset, and loudness varies by less than 1 dB between 3 and 11 voices. Not yet tested on a real minilogue xd.
Linux install steps are not tested yet.
